Rapper and superfan Forgiato Blow, dubbed mayor of Trump Town, visits Danny Jones. Blow built fame with songs praising Donald Trump. The studio talk opens with videos of other MAGA figures.

They joke about Roger Stone, tattoos, and party loyalists on screen. Blow explains the act, the music, and the business behind it. Jones probes how deep the belief runs beyond the show. The episode is a colorful tour inside a corner of Trump fandom where music, memes, and loyalty merge into one loud public brand. The visit is loud, funny, and fully unfiltered.
podcast-joerogan-B7y3qcgSRY8:
Stanford professor Garry Nolan joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2372. Nolan is an immunologist who has turned his lab skills toward UFO evidence, studying claimed crash materials and the brains of people who report close encounters. Few scientists of his rank speak this openly on the topic.

He tells Rogan what his tests can and cannot show, and why he thinks the subject deserves real study. Rogan asks about the witnesses Nolan has examined and the data still locked away. The episode brings a working scientist's care to a field built on rumor, one sample at a time.
